statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Current Tail is low because delayed NQ evidence shows a substantial retracement from the overnight high rather than persistent extreme holding.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. The principal conditional risk checkpoint is the U.S. cash open, Flash PMI and immediate post-release sequence.
headline: Low Tail with extreme background Stress; the U.S. open and Flash PMI remain the narrow conditional danger window.
body: Delayed NQ around 06:03 UTC was near 31,002 after an overnight high near 31,065, indicating meaningful retracement rather than a verified no-mean-reversion path. Fresh Finviz context is partial: semiconductors are broadly positive while megacaps are evenly split; oil-supply headlines have eased some pressure.

lookbackSummary: Across the prior 24 clock-hour assessments, Tail was mostly low, briefly rose to 27% around the prior U.S. open, then returned to low as retracement and mixed structure reappeared. Stress stayed high to extreme throughout most of the window.
outlookSummary: The next 24 hours remain low-Tail in the base case outside the narrow 13:30-15:30 UTC U.S. open/PMI/Fed/EIA sequence. Forecast Tail rises only conditionally if opening direction persists through shallow pullbacks, failed retracements or a coherent second leg.

forecast.analysis: Delayed NQ around 06:04 UTC was near 31,002 after trading as high as about 31,065, showing a meaningful pullback rather than persistent extreme holding. Finviz context is fresh but partial: semiconductors are broadly positive while megacaps are split. Tail remains low.
drivers: Delayed NQ retraced materially from its overnight high
Fresh Finviz semiconductors 7/7 positive but megacaps split 4/4

news.title: Nasdaq hits intraday record high on tech boost, Mideast negotiation hopes
Saudi Arabia restarts East-West oil pipeline, sources say

forecast.analysis: European pre-open liquidity is the next test. Tail stays low unless a directional break holds near an extreme and retracements become repeatedly shallow or fail outright.
drivers: Pullback depth remains the main Tail test

forecast.analysis: The European cash open should clarify whether overnight strength broadens or mean reversion persists. Two-way trade keeps Tail low; sustained directional efficiency would be the escalation condition.
With Europe established, rates, oil and technology breadth can confirm or contradict direction. Tail remains low unless NQ repeatedly extends after weak retracements.
U.S. premarket participation begins to build. Stress rises gradually, but Tail remains low unless price enters the U.S. morning already aligned and resistant to mean reversion.
drivers: Flash U.S. PMI later at 13:45 UTC

forecast.analysis: The cash open and Flash PMI are approaching. WATCH-level Tail is conditional on pre-open extreme holding, shallow pullbacks or an unusually efficient directional build into 13:30 UTC.
drivers: Pre-open extreme holding would raise Tail

forecast.analysis: This hour contains the 13:30 UTC cash open and 13:45 UTC Flash U.S. PMI. Elevated Tail is conditional on opening-auction direction persisting through shallow pullbacks, failed retracements or repeated extension.
drivers: Conditional shallow pullbacks or failed retracements

forecast.analysis: The first full post-PMI hour also contains Governor Barr at 14:05 UTC and the EIA petroleum report at 14:30 UTC. Elevated Tail requires a coherent second leg or continued mean-reversion failure after the first impulse.
By this hour, orderly two-way discovery would lower Tail toward WATCH. Persistence near session extremes after the event cluster would keep risk elevated instead.
drivers: Persistent session-extreme holding would keep risk elevated

forecast.analysis: Mid-morning U.S. trade should reveal whether the opening move is durable. Tail stays at WATCH only if pullbacks remain weak and cross-asset confirmation stays aligned.
drivers: Pullback quality after the event cluster

forecast.analysis: As the event impulse ages, Tail falls toward the low band unless repeated extensions continue. Mixed breadth or deeper retracements would argue for normalization.
Late-morning conditions should become more mechanical. Without fresh one-way structure, the base case is normal mean-reverting behavior despite still-high background Stress.
drivers: No new Tier-1 scheduled catalyst in the hour
Mean reversion remains the base case

forecast.analysis: Early U.S. afternoon has no scheduled Tier-1 macro catalyst in this window. Tail remains low unless a fresh geopolitical or cross-asset shock creates persistent directional structure.
drivers: Geopolitical headlines remain an unscheduled risk
Fresh one-way structure required for Tail escalation

forecast.analysis: Afternoon liquidity can amplify momentum, but low Tail persists absent extreme holding, failed retracements or a new catalyst stack.
drivers: Cross-asset conflict would reduce directional conviction

forecast.analysis: Heading toward power hour, the key checkpoint is whether any prior directional move still denies meaningful retracement. Otherwise the base case remains normal.
drivers: Persistence of any prior directional move
Meaningful retracement would support low Tail

forecast.analysis: Power-hour risk rises modestly only if the session is already one-way and price remains pinned near an extreme. A balanced session keeps Tail low.
The final cash hour is conditional on accumulated structure: persistent trend efficiency would raise risk, while a two-way day supports low Tail.
drivers: Extreme holding remains the key Tail checkpoint

forecast.analysis: After the cash close, thinner liquidity can widen moves but does not by itself imply pathological Tail. Cross-asset stabilization would support normalization.
drivers: Thin liquidity alone does not raise Tail

forecast.analysis: Early evening futures trade should remain low-Tail unless a new geopolitical headline or abrupt rate move creates a clean directional break.
drivers: Abrupt rate moves are a conditional amplifier

forecast.analysis: Overnight liquidity becomes thinner. Tail remains low in the base case, with any escalation requiring observed repeated extension rather than event importance alone.
drivers: Observed repeated extension required for Tail escalation
Event importance alone does not raise Tail

forecast.analysis: Asian-session handoff is a fresh structural checkpoint. A contained range or normal pullbacks keeps Tail low; sustained extreme holding would be the exception.
Asia cash markets can confirm or challenge the overnight path. Without aligned one-way NQ structure and cross-asset confirmation, Tail remains low.
Late-Asia trade should favor low Tail if retracements remain available. A new oil or geopolitical shock could raise Stress first, not Tail automatically.
drivers: Oil/geopolitical shocks primarily raise Stress first
Mean-reversion availability remains the key Tail test

forecast.analysis: Approaching the next European pre-open, the base case remains low Tail. The next major U.S. data cluster sits later on September 24, outside this forecast horizon.
drivers: September 24 U.S. data lie outside this 24-hour horizon
Low Tail remains the base case absent new structure

forecastDetail.comment: Observed delayed NQ shows a meaningful pullback from the overnight high; fresh supplementary breadth is mixed outside semiconductors, supporting low Tail.
European pre-open is a conditional range-break test; Tail stays low unless direction holds with weak retracements.
European cash-open two-way trade would confirm low Tail; sustained directional efficiency is the escalation condition.
Cross-asset confirmation matters more once Europe is established; repeated failed retracements would be the Tail warning.
U.S. premarket participation raises Stress, but Tail stays low without resistant one-way structure.
WATCH reflects proximity to the U.S. open and PMI, conditional on pre-open extreme holding or shallow pullbacks.
